description: This source file contains shell functions for testing a library script related to sub-tests. It includes functions to write, execute, and verify sub-tests, as well as to compare output with expected results, with a focus on testing the 'test-lib.sh' shell library in a testing environment.

methods.name: write_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Creates a sub-test directory and script, forming the basis for executing a test of 'test-lib.sh'.

methods.name: _run_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Runs a sub-test against a specific test script, handling various options and environment setup.

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Writes a test script and runs a passing sub-test.

methods.name: write_and_run_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Writes a test script and runs a failing sub-test.

methods.name: run_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Runs a successful sub-test without re-writing the test script.

methods.name: run_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Runs a failing sub-test without re-writing the test script.

methods.name: _check_sub_test_lib_test_common
methods.description: Verifies that the output of a test matches the expected output by comparing 'expect.out' and 'out' files.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test
methods.description: Checks that the test output matches the expected output and that error output is empty.

methods.name: check_sub_test_lib_test_err
methods.description: Checks that the test output matches the expected output and verifies error output.
